metadata.title: Sci-Fi Cybernetic Portrait with Radial Perspective Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A centered cybernetic head with glowing blue features and typography that recedes into a central vanishing point.

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, airbrushed portrait of a futuristic cybernetic head encased in a metallic helmet, featuring glowing blue eyes and a forehead aperture, with large-scale display text at the top that stretches toward the center.
coreVisualRelationships: The top text acts as a visual funnel leading the eye to the forehead's center.
The glowing blue eyes and forehead light create a triangular focal point.
The dark background provides high contrast for the luminous blue and metallic silver elements.
Symmetrical mechanical details on the sides of the helmet frame the central face.
coreInvariants: Radial perspective on the primary display text
Dominant electric blue and black color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, centered cybernetic head occupies 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing circular aperture on the forehead serves as the vanishing point for the perspective lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, follows the perspective lines down to the forehead, and then rests on the glowing eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space surrounds the head, emphasizing the internal glow.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Electric blue used for highlights, glows, and internal lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and navy blue used for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red and copper tones in the mechanical tubes at the base.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the luminous blue centers and the dark peripheral shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm primary colors like bright yellow or orange
Limit to cool-toned metallics and blues

letterConstructionRules: Letters are extruded toward a central vanishing point
Outlined stroke style with no solid fill
Extreme vertical stretching on the lower portions of the glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' and 'F' in the bottom text feature horizontal bars that do not connect to the vertical stem
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary wide-tracked, futuristic sans-serif at the bottom to ground the composition.

avoid: Solid fills for the top text

candidateDirections.reason: The base skeleton of the bottom text matches the 80s tech aesthetic.
The top text requires manual perspective manipulation that standard fonts cannot achieve alone.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical airbrushed illustration of a cybernetic head in a metallic helmet with glowing blue eyes and a central forehead light against a black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom outlined lettering at the top, using a radial perspective tool to stretch the bottom of the letters toward the forehead light. Add a wide-tracked futuristic sans-serif at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the top text stretched toward the center?
Are the eyes and forehead aperture glowing blue?

adjustableVariables: Degree of perspective stretch on the text
Complexity of the mechanical details on the helmet
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of known individuals
postGenerationChecks: Check that text perspective lines converge at the forehead.
Ensure the blue glow does not wash out the facial details.
Verify the bottom text is legible and centered.
Confirm the metallic textures have appropriate highlights.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Cybernetic Portrait + Radial Perspective Typography + Electric Blue Glow Palette
